name: Fixed-timestep game loop scheduler (MainLoop.js animate)
description: Given display frame timestamps, computes exactly what a fixed-timestep game loop does each frame: how many physics updates run, the render interpolation factor (alpha), the moving-average FPS and the 240-update panic guard, as in MainLoop.js. Used to choose the physics step and prove the loop stays stable on slow and fast screens.
author: Skillpack contributors

provenance.license_check: GitHub API license field read and the license file itself read
provenance.primary_role: animate() fixed-timestep accumulator, fps moving average, panic guard, setMaxAllowedFPS and resetFrameDelta
provenance.reference_values: Every case was generated by loading the pinned src/mainloop.js in Node.js with a scripted requestAnimationFrame queue (reference/upstream_harness.js) and recording update counts, draw alpha and end(fps, panic) per frame.

region.notes: Game rules are illustrative defaults, not real-world rules.

audit.principle: code decides, model explains, craftsman (usta) approves

usta_approval.what_to_check: that the physics step and panic handling match the target devices (phones at 60 Hz, older laptops at 30 Hz).

external_audit.notes: Local tests only; no independent audit has been performed.

budget.enforcement: Raw CLI byte limit and POSIX alarm; strict schema, finite values and nesting checks; MCP subprocess killed/reaped after the timeout. One active calculation. Not a hostile-code sandbox.

dependencies.runtime: Python standard library plus jsonschema (schema check) only

data.logging: none; input contents are never logged or echoed in errors

mcp.instructions: One local deterministic tool. Explain its result and limits; the code decides, a human (usta) approves consequential use. No network access.

limitations: Simulates the scheduler only, not the work done inside update/draw. Timestamps must be non-decreasing. fpsAlpha=0.9 and fpsUpdateInterval=1000 ms are the upstream defaults and are not configurable. max_fps=0 (stop) is not supported.
port_notes: Line-by-line port of animate(): minFrameDelay skip, frameDelta accumulation, fps exponential moving average every >1000 ms, update loop with the 240-step panic break, draw(frameDelta/timestep). start() is modelled as the first timestamp drawing once and resetting lastFrameTimeMs/lastFpsUpdate. discard_on_panic models the documented end() pattern calling MainLoop.resetFrameDelta().
flow_role: Step 9 (döngü kontrolü): confirm the chosen physics step (default 1000/60 ms) runs 1 update per frame at 60 Hz, catches up at 30 Hz, and that a tab-switch stall triggers panic + discard instead of a spiral. The step value is written into the HTML (G012), whose embedded loop is the upstream mainloop.min.js.
